notes.title: Version 1.5 Update
notes.content:
All along, our game didn't have mid-game progress saving, and the game was just too difficult.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067447/428a2d120a6d50030a9add380af0de62ea007d18.png[/img]

After a long period of development efforts, we finally have progress saving implemented. If you exit the game halfway, the game will automatically save your current progress. The next time you enter the game, you can simply continue your search from where you left off!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067447/2b8fd6f29d6698f08d964ac730b3cd4025e46c48.png[/img]

Notably, after completing the game, if you enter the game again, the completed levels will automatically reset, starting a new round of searching.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067447/6c3afc59f50ae8afe10ea7cac5b7047682bf03c3.png[/img]

Additionally, we've fixed several minor issues. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Important Updates for Version 1.4
notes.content:
Dear friends,

Based on existing reviews and feedback, we have added two new features that significantly reduce the game's difficulty.

The first feature is the Cat Detective:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067447/72d43b2070006ac57feb198804f6a14487b43e7b.png[/img]
This Cat Detective appears in the upper left corner of the screen. Each time you click on the Cat Detective, it will automatically navigate to an undiscovered item, and this item will now be positioned exactly in the center of the screen. Please observe carefully. After using the Cat Detective, it needs to rest for 2 minutes, during which a 2-minute countdown will appear below the Cat Detective icon. There are no other side effects besides this.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067447/a960a338d97696c2cb0e3711b239061ac5974ce0.png[/img]

The second feature is the Cat Glasses:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067447/cb5456ea9387f7c1b634b0b1982a3c99502e067c.png[/img]
Below the Cat Detective button in the upper left corner of the screen, there's a new Cat Glasses feature. It's turned off by default. When clicked, items that have already been found on the screen will be marked in blue! This is a rare use of color in our game. If you don't like the coloring effect, you can click the button again to turn it off. This helps in finding undiscovered duplicate items!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067447/ab2c3fd4f47030346ef046a3c269e658817fc379.png[/img]

In addition, we've also updated:
1. The screen zooming speed is now much faster
2. You can still drag and move the screen normally after zooming out
3. Changing resolution now uses toggle buttons instead of a dropdown menu
4. A new MAX resolution button has been added to the settings menu
5. A return to main menu button has been added to the level selection menu

Regarding saves:
This game doesn't have a mid-level save feature. This is because many item searches involve multiple processes and steps, and saving would involve many issues. Re-entering levels would require resetting these things. Sometimes I think friends or children might come to play, and I'd open the game to let them try a level, so having all levels start fresh by default is more user-friendly. Normal gameplay time for a level is around 10 minutes. Of course, it might be harder than I thought T.T
We believe that with the two new hint features, the game should become easier and more accessible.
